research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Truv is researching intermediary data access server architecture and authentication interface rendering and mirroring in a distributed architecture. The unified authentication server obtains credentials for accessing third party applications and generating user data reports, and enables a user to be authenticated with multiple providers by accessing and mirroring their authentication web pages. Together these efforts focus on secure data access, credential management, and multi provider authentication.

product.name: Income and Employment Verification
product.description: Truv verifies income and employment by allowing users to connect their payroll or employer account, covering 90% of the U.S. workforce.

product.name: Employment History Verification
product.description: Truv provides access to employment history data, including employer name, job title, and employment dates, through payroll integrations and document processing.

product.name: Insurance Verification
product.description: Truv offers instant insurance verification by allowing users to log in to their insurance provider, covering a majority of U.S. policies.
